style="rounded=1;arcSize=2;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#D5DBDB;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=14;fontSize=12;fontColor=#232F3E;" value="<font style='font-size:16px'><b>How to read it</b></font><br><br><font color='#E07B00'><b>━ ① Ingress</b></font><br>Internet → internet gateway → ALB in the public subnets (TLS from the ACM wildcard) → pod IPs on nodes in the private subnets → RDS in the intra subnets, reachable on 3306 only from the node security group.<br><br><font color='#1A73E8'><b>━ ② Control plane and auth</b></font><br>The EKS control plane runs in an AWS-managed VPC and reaches the nodes through ENIs in the private subnets. prometheus. requests are sent through the Cognito login first.<br><br><font color='#D93025'><b>━ ③ Egress</b></font><br>Private subnets → the single NAT gateway in AZ 1 → internet gateway → out. Saves about $65/month versus one NAT per AZ; if AZ 1 fails, every AZ loses outbound access.<br><br><font color='#188038'><b>━ ④ CI federation</b></font><br>GitHub Actions presents its OIDC token, STS returns short-lived credentials, and the job pushes to ECR. The infra pipeline applies Terraform the same way, behind the prod environment gate.<br><br><font color='#188038'><b>━ ⑤ Private AWS access</b></font><br>ECR (api + dkr) and STS through interface endpoints in all three private subnets; S3 through the free gateway endpoint. Image pulls never cross the NAT.<br><br><font color='#8C4FFF'><b>━ ⑥ Spot interruptions</b></font><br>EventBridge rules → SQS → Karpenter drains and replaces the node.<br><br><font color='#5A6B7B'><b>━ ⑦ Logging</b></font><br>VPC flow logs and the EKS control-plane logs (api, audit, authenticator, controllerManager, scheduler) → CloudWatch.<br><br><font color='#879196'><b>┅ grey dashed</b></font> = configuration, not traffic.<br><br><hr><b>Subnet plan</b><br>Public 10.0.0–2.0/24 · ALB, NAT<br>Private 10.0.10–12.0/24 · nodes, endpoint ENIs<br>Intra 10.0.20–22.0/24 · RDS, no route out<br><br><b>At rest (Oct 2026)</b><br>Torn down; <font color='#1E8E3E'><b>●</b></font> kept: Route 53, ACM, Cognito, IAM / OIDC, KMS, ECR, S3. About $4–5/month resting, about $213/month running." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="690" width="410" x="1960" y="215" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="users" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;endSize=5;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#E07B00;fontColor=#E07B00;fontSize=10;fontStyle=1;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0.3;entryY=0;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;flowAnimation=1;libavoidRouting=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;" target="igw" value="① HTTPS"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="150" y="325" /> <mxPoint x="507" y="325" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e7" edge="1" parent="1" source="igw" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;endSize=5;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#D93025;fontColor=#D93025;fontSize=10;fontStyle=1;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=0.8;exitY=0;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0.51;entryY=1;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;flowAnimation=1;libavoidRouting=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;" target="egress" value="③ out"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e11" edge="1" parent="1" source="github" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;endSize=5;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#188038;fontColor=#188038;fontSize=10;fontStyle=1;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;flowAnimation=1;libavoidRouting=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;" target="iam" value="④ OIDC → STS"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
How to read it
━ ① Ingress
Internet → internet gateway → ALB in the public subnets (TLS from the ACM wildcard) → pod IPs on nodes in the private subnets → RDS in the intra subnets, reachable on 3306 only from the node security group.
━ ② Control plane and auth
The EKS control plane runs in an AWS-managed VPC and reaches the nodes through ENIs in the private subnets. prometheus. requests are sent through the Cognito login first.
━ ③ Egress
Private subnets → the single NAT gateway in AZ 1 → internet gateway → out. Saves about $65/month versus one NAT per AZ; if AZ 1 fails, every AZ loses outbound access.
━ ④ CI federation
GitHub Actions presents its OIDC token, STS returns short-lived credentials, and the job pushes to ECR. The infra pipeline applies Terraform the same way, behind the prod environment gate.
━ ⑤ Private AWS access
ECR (api + dkr) and STS through interface endpoints in all three private subnets; S3 through the free gateway endpoint. Image pulls never cross the NAT.
━ ⑥ Spot interruptions
EventBridge rules → SQS → Karpenter drains and replaces the node.
━ ⑦ Logging
VPC flow logs and the EKS control-plane logs (api, audit, authenticator, controllerManager, scheduler) → CloudWatch.
┅ grey dashed = configuration, not traffic.
Subnet plan
Public 10.0.0–2.0/24 · ALB, NAT
Private 10.0.10–12.0/24 · nodes, endpoint ENIs
Intra 10.0.20–22.0/24 · RDS, no route out
At rest (Oct 2026)
Torn down; ● kept: Route 53, ACM, Cognito, IAM / OIDC, KMS, ECR, S3. About $4–5/month resting, about $213/month running.
